name: Calendar event file
summary: Make an ics calendar event file
author: friday-core
description: Creates a standards-correct iCalendar (.ics) event that Outlook, Google Calendar and phones can import, with title, start, end or duration, location, notes, a reminder before the event and a daily, weekly, monthly or yearly repeat. Text is escaped and long lines are folded as RFC 5545 requires. Local times are read in the offset you give (default India, UTC+5:30) and written as UTC. No calendar account is used.
